Directly reduces the field enhancement factor β at geometric discontinuities to suppress partial discharge inception
Passive mechanical mitigation addressing root-cause field concentration rather than detecting a degradation signature
Validated by an executable PD-onset comparison test with a stated falsification threshold
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to suppress localized electric-field concentration at dielectric edge/interface discontinuities so as to prevent partial-discharge-initiated dielectric breakdown without increasing dielectric volume or adding higher-strength material.
parsed.viable_reason: Corona/shunt grading rings at electrode and dielectric edge interfaces are a physically sound, standard HV practice that reshapes the field and reduces β, and the proposed PD-onset comparison test is executable at the stated scale.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The prior arts are monitoring/inference and chemical-dosing schemes with no physical field-grading structure, so relocating a corona ring from conventional HV terminal practice to the dielectric edge interface to homogenize the field is not the routine application of the closest art.
